question:
I'm trying to pass my dbt macro into model config like that:

{{ config(
custom_macro=my_macro
)
}}

my_macro is defined in /macros/my_macro.sql

Then I'm trying to run this macro in custom materialization like that:

{% if config.get("custom_macro", None) %}
        {% do my_macro('foo') %}
{% endif %}

But I get an error at compilation stage: TypeError: can not serialize 'MacroGenerator' object

Okay, then I tried to pass macro name in string and tried to run it using adapter.dispatch or ref() and all methods thath I had googled. But no success.

Can anyone give me an advise how can I pass macro object in a right way or how can I dynamically run macro by macroname?
title: DBT: How can I pass an macros into model config to run this macro in materialization which is used by model?
answer:
To execute a macro from a custom materialization you can create a parameter with the config value on your custom materialization script, and add if/else statements to check which macro to execute.

  {%- set custom_macro = config.get('custom_macro', none) -%}
  {% do log('macro is: ' ~ custom_macro, info = true) %}
  
  {% if custom_macro =='my_macro' %}
    {% do log('macro execution: ' ~ custom_macro, info = true) %}
    {{ my_macro('table') }}
  {% endif %}

In the model configuration indicate the macro you want to execute in the custom_macro parameter.

{{ config(
   ...
    custom_macro ='my_macro'
) }}

My macro is the following one:

{% macro my_macro(table_name) %}
  {% do log('table_name is: ' ~ table_name, info = true) %}
{% endmacro %}

There could be more optimal solutions but at least this approach works for me.
